data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. The maximum configurable audit log retention within the CloudDesk Admin Console is capped at 12 months. For longer compliance retention requirements, we recommend integrating with an external SIEM solution such as Splunk or Sumo Logic via our API or SFTP export feature to store logs externally. This has been logged as a feature request for extending native retention. [T-4511] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
